title: Customizations
description: V18 — One "Manage" surface (Martin's direction from the Nov 18 Customization Squad Sync, built on V17's calm session panel). The Customizations modal becomes Manage: true globals at the top (Settings, Remotes, Models, Extensions), then each agent harness (Copilot, Claude, Codex) with only the customization types it supports. The Environment › Workspace › Agent pickers become one Remote picker; the agent comes from where you are in the nav. Only user-level items appear, grouped by where they come from: Yours, From the harness, From VS Code. Workspace customizations stay with the repo and the session's Customizations panel, which handles in-session troubleshooting.
